reponse: The flag is now dashboards_v2, and FEATURE_FLAGS in .env.local is ignored since the change moved flags to the API [2][3]. Run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2` with the API running, then hard-reload the page [2][3]. You can check it with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [3]. The Slack advice to use FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash is out of date [1][2].
